meaning:
συν-θάπτω
to bury together with: in symbolical sense, of baptism, σὐτῷ (with Christ), Rom.6:4, Col.2:12.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might…
having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
